# 足球数研所 (miaomiaodi.vip)
> SaaS platform for football data research and AI-powered match analysis.

## What this site does
- Provides pre-match analysis reports using statistical models (Dixon-Coles, Bivariate Poisson, LightGBM)
- Covers 10+ football leagues worldwide
- Uses SHAP for model explainability
- Tracks prediction accuracy with Brier Score and calibration metrics

## What this site does NOT do
- Does not provide betting advice or recommendations
- Does not accept wagers or process gambling transactions
- Does not guarantee outcomes

## Subscription
- Free tier: limited access to match analysis
- Paid tier: full access to all reports and model dashboard
